I just wanted to check the status of our change in equipment for start of

The folks in IT are asking me where that loaner PC is so they can install all

contact. I just wanted to check with you to see if you need any additional 
information from me - or if I can be of help in any way. Thanks!!

Steve

Subject: Viking press releases of October 18th and October 23rd, 2001.

<<PR.JAN18.01.doc>> <<PROct_23_01.doc>> 
You may be interested in the attached press releases which Viking has
issued over the past few business days.

In these uncertain times, a healthy balance sheet, a solid team of
talent, performing properties, and a proactive hedging program all
contribute to Viking having a stable cash flow and distribution forecast
through the year 2002. Viking is well positioned to realize on
opportunities, as they may arise in these periods of volatility. In
managing the assets of the Trust through all phases of the commodity
price cycles, we continue to focus on the current yield and long term
return objectives for Viking Unitholders.

Regards, akp
